description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for initializing core components of the SalesManager application during testing. It includes methods for setting up and cleaning database entities such as languages, countries, zones, and currencies, mainly for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: AbstractInitSalesManagerCore
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to initialize and clean core reference data (languages, countries, currencies, zones) in the database for testing the SalesManager application.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Prepares the database by cleaning all core reference data before tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes languages, countries, and zones as part of test setup.

methods.name: initZones
methods.description: Loads and creates zone data from configuration files, associating zones with countries and languages.

methods.name: initCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries based on ISO codes and locale display names.

methods.name: initLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined ISO codes.

methods.name: initCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entries based on predefined codes and mappings.

methods.name: cleanAll
methods.description: Deletes all core reference data such as currencies, countries, languages, and zones from the database.

methods.name: cleanZone
methods.description: Removes all zone records from the database.

methods.name: cleanCurrency
methods.description: Removes all currency records from the database.

methods.name: cleanCountry
methods.description: Removes all country records from the database.

methods.name: cleanLanguage
methods.description: Removes all language records from the database.

methods.name: checkEmptyDatabase
methods.description: Verifies that all entity tables are empty; fails test if any entities remain.

methods.name: listEntities
methods.description: Helper method to list all entities of a given class from the database.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the JPA EntityManager from utility class.
